items.html: It is thus found that the two Mochin called HB of ZA are in the two Yesods of AVI, for the phase of Yesod is always male, whether in Aba or in Ima. And the two crowns of Daat are in the two crowns of their Yesods, both of which are female. From this you will understand why Daat is called “two crowns” in Idra Zuta, for they are the phase of the two crowns of their Yesods.
